title: Exception
tagline: A turn-based game of rule-breaking aliens — every race is a patch to the rulebook. Plan together, then watch together.
description:
Exception is a computer-native board game about aliens who rewrite the rules they play by. Ten races, each one a patch to the rulebook: some bend adjacency, some steal Sway, some refuse to die on schedule. You plan with the other seats, then watch the whole turn resolve at once.

Play a solo skirmish against bots at Cadet, Officer or Admiral, watch the tutorial game through one player's eyes with the bot's reasoning on screen, spectate a bot-only match with every card visible, or open a GameHub room and invite friends by link — empty seats are filled by bots, and a dropped player's seat is held until they return.
highlights: Ten alien races, each a different patch to the rules
Solo skirmish, watchable tutorial and spectator mode
Multiplayer through GameHub rooms — bots fill empty seats
